nextRun.notes: Resume the blocked startup-board lane with fresh Wellfound and Instahyre attempts and traverse more Cutshort API detail pages. Then recheck the 24–26 August employer deadlines, page further through Indeed and LinkedIn variants, and sweep every lane again.

sourceLanes.label: LinkedIn Jobs
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Fresh page-100-plus results and narrower city variants for pricing, fraud, planning, insights, reporting, and junior data-engineering queries, then recheck today's additions for closure
sourceLanes.notes: The past-24-hour sweep covered 18 keyword families across four target locations and starts 0, 25, 50, and 75, producing 288 result requests and 162 unseen IDs. Six direct listings were verified and added: Festo India, PrepClever, PW, Synchrony, RWS, and Dalm. Senior mismatches and unpaid low-signal internships were rejected. Synchrony was canonicalized to its current employer career page.

sourceLanes.label: Normal LinkedIn hiring posts
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: fresh employee and recruiter posts using reporting, revenue operations, risk, data engineering, fresher, graduate, and referral variants after public indexing refreshes
sourceLanes.notes: Normal LinkedIn posts were searched independently across four query families. Publicly indexed results were one month to one year old, reposts, already closed, or lacked an inspectable current hiring route. No normal post was promoted without a current original post and usable application or contact destination.

sourceLanes.label: Company careers and ATS pages
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Fresh Workday, Taleo, SmartRecruiters, Lever, Greenhouse, and company-hosted pages, prioritizing roles with deadlines inside seven days
sourceLanes.notes: The ATS and company-career sweep found Ameriprise Financial's Data Analyst role in Gurugram and Noida. Its current canonical Workday page explicitly counts internships, academic projects, and coursework toward the 1–3 year range and has a 26 August deadline, so it was added as Tier 1. An expired Labcorp duplicate and senior or out-of-scope ATS results were rejected.

sourceLanes.label: Startup boards
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: More Cutshort API detail pagination, current YC company boards, then retry Wellfound and Instahyre with accessible sessions
sourceLanes.notes: The oldest incomplete lane was resumed first. Instahyre still returned HTTP 403. Wellfound search results were discoverable, but the two relevant direct pages for FOXO and My Type returned HTTP 410 and were excluded. RegisterKaro's Cutshort role was live but dated to 2 January 2025 with no recent refresh evidence, so it was also excluded. The current YC query returned only a 3+ year role. The lane remains partial.

sourceLanes.label: Specialist and early-career portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Additional Internshala pages for BI, MIS, research, risk, and operations analytics; then Unstop and Hirist detail pages
sourceLanes.notes: Eight Internshala role categories were swept across four target cities, producing 480 unseen slugs. Nine roles posted on or after 22 August were inspected directly. Seasoul Cosmetics' Finance and Accounts Intern and The Pet Point's Supply Chain and Logistics Operations Intern were relevant, live, and added. The remaining fresh roles were unrelated HR, marketing, or electrical positions. Unstop and Hirist remain partial.

sourceLanes.label: Broad job portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Page further through current Indeed city and synonym searches, then retry Foundit and Naukri client-rendered detail extraction and canonicalize employer destinations where available
sourceLanes.notes: Naukri remained blocked and Foundit results were stale or closed. Indeed discovery and direct job IDs were accessible this run. Five current role pages were verified and added: Simply Vyapar Apps, Learnurture, V Patrol AI, OcIT, and Customs Wise India. Existing ByteDance and American Express discoveries were correctly deduplicated. OcIT was kept in Tier 3 because its fresher label conflicts with leadership expectations.
